timestamp.Description: Device timestamp of the sample (Tobii Glasses 2 API clock).

x_coordinate.Description: Horizontal cyclopean gaze position, normalized 0-1 in the scene-camera video frame.

y_coordinate.Description: Vertical cyclopean gaze position, normalized 0-1 in the scene-camera video frame.

gaze_status.Description: Tracking/validity status flag for the 2D gaze sample.

gaze_dir_left_x.Description: Left-eye 3D gaze direction unit vector, X component.

gaze_dir_left_y.Description: Left-eye 3D gaze direction unit vector, Y component.

gaze_dir_left_z.Description: Left-eye 3D gaze direction unit vector, Z component.

gaze_dir_right_x.Description: Right-eye 3D gaze direction unit vector, X component.

gaze_dir_right_y.Description: Right-eye 3D gaze direction unit vector, Y component.

gaze_dir_right_z.Description: Right-eye 3D gaze direction unit vector, Z component.

pupil_center_left_x.Description: Left-eye pupil centre position, X component.

pupil_center_left_y.Description: Left-eye pupil centre position, Y component.

pupil_center_left_z.Description: Left-eye pupil centre position, Z component.

pupil_center_right_x.Description: Right-eye pupil centre position, X component.

pupil_center_right_y.Description: Right-eye pupil centre position, Y component.

pupil_center_right_z.Description: Right-eye pupil centre position, Z component.
